description: Builds HyperFrames compositions for any code-built video - the project scaffold (hyperframes.json, pinned CLI, a build.py that emits the composition from measured timings), building from a real product UI (capture the real app, compose from its own classes, a measure pass), word-highlight captions in any language including Arabic and Hebrew, real footage with frame-exact windows, rendering, and a catalogue of HyperFrames, GSAP and render traps. A layer over the upstream hyperframes skills and an executor under video-studio. Use when video-studio reaches the build step of a code-built film. Triggers: "build the composition", "HyperFrames", "render the video", "add captions", "word-by-word captions", "put this footage in the video".
